dedupe_keys.name: water supply tipping point data and code

description: Emily Berglund at North Carolina State University publishes an R workflow for detecting water-supply tipping points from simulated deficits. WaterSupplyTippingPoints.R converts deficit time series to a Sustainability Index, applies decision-tree change-point detection and selects tipping points with a stated rule. The January 2023 deposit includes four CSV output files, each covering 100 randomised runs for 16 climate-shift factors from 0.25 to 1.00. Management cases include no action, retrofitting and retrofitting with reactive or proactive drought restrictions. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Input deficit files are separately archived as Zenodo 3971213. The source does not state a geographic case, timestep or full R dependency list, so these remain unknown. The code can analyse scenario simulation outputs; it does not itself reproduce the underlying agent-based water-supply model. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. Threshold choices and stochastic sampling should be checked before transferring results.
